restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมพรเทวา PDV Dental Clinic จัดฟัน เชียงใหม่
text: I called at 9am and was able to get an appointment for the same afternoon.  The dentist and her assistant are very professional and experienced.  My 10 year old son had a tooth extraction here and it was done quickly and efficiently.  Even though the dentist was not a pediatric dentist, she really knew how to talk to my son to calm his fears, get him to relax and distract him.  Her assistant was very well-trained and she helped my son by holding and massaging his hand to reassure him. I felt the dentist worked very well with her assistant as a team.  Even though the dental office renovations are a bit old-fashioned, it is very clean and the dentist's professional skills and manner were top-notch.

text:
Homely dentist with reasonable service fee. Interior was well-maintained and clean but front sign was super run-down.

I called in and was able to get an appointment on the same day. The dentist was very kind and careful with dental cleaning which I paid 700 THB for the service.

I was a bit skeptical of the clinic as it looks very old from the outside. To my surprise, the interior was clean. The dental chair was old but in good condition. All in all, if you see past the outside of the clinic, great and friendly service inside.
